summary: Comprehensive Marketing AI and Huge domain alignment interview prep. Covers: Huge's 'Intelligent Experiences' positioning, client portfolio AI use cases (Google/McDonald's/Nike/IKEA/Verizon), Marketing Mix Modeling deep dive (Meridian/Robyn comparison, adstock types, saturation curves, Bayesian MMM, ATT/cookieless attribution), Multi-Touch Attribution (Markov/Shapley, identity resolution, post-cookie world), GenAI for marketing (content generation, brand voice RAG, campaign agents), HDBSCAN deep dive (mathematical intuition, UMAP combination, hyperparameters, marketing applications), Customer Data Platform (CDP) + personalization architecture, IKEA e-commerce and Verizon recommendation system designs, client presentation frameworks, and emerging trends (multimodal AI, EU AI Act, edge AI for retail).
